findings.title: Immediate email cancellations still consume SendGrid’s cancellation limit
findings.body: This branch posts `status: "cancel"` directly to SendGrid instead of marking the reminder for the cron job. SendGrid keeps these cancelled scheduled sends until their scheduled dates, so workflow deletions, step deletions, and reschedules can still accumulate pending cancellations and hit the 100-cancellation limit this change is intended to avoid. For rescheduled bookings, this branch also leaves the reminder row in the database without setting `cancelled`, so the cron job will not process it.

findings.title: A reminder can send before the periodic cancellation job runs
findings.body: Cancelled reminders are only sent to SendGrid for cancellation when this cron endpoint runs. With a 15-minute cron interval, a reminder scheduled less than 15 minutes away can be sent before the next run processes it, even though its booking was already cancelled or rescheduled. This leaves a window where the original reminder is still delivered.
